info.name: ChangeCars - Complete App Filter Data
info.description: One unpaginated public snapshot for storing and filtering at app level. Start the local backend or change baseUrl after deploying. No auth required.

exec: pm.test('Public rows and scoped relationships', () => body.vehicles.forEach(car => { pm.expect(['PUBLISHED','RESERVED']).to.include(car.status); pm.expect(car.model.value).to.equal(car.make.slug+':'+car.model.slug); pm.expect(car).not.to.have.property('vin'); pm.expect(car).not.to.have.property('registration'); pm.expect(car).not.to.have.property('popularityScore'); }));

pm.test('Initial make counts cover complete data', () => { pm.expect(body.options.makes.reduce((sum, item) => sum+item.count, 0)).to.equal(body.total); body.options.makes.forEach(item => pm.expect(item.count).to.equal(body.vehicles.filter(car => car.make.slug === item.slug).length)); });

pm.test('Null specifications omitted from options', () => ['seats','engineCapacityCc','powerKw','drivetrain'].forEach(key => body.options[key].forEach(item => pm.expect(item.value).not.to.equal(null))));

pm.test('Ranges match rows', () => ['price','year','mileage','engineCapacityCc','powerKw'].forEach(key => { const values = body.vehicles.map(car => car[key]).filter(value => value !== null); const sorted = values.sort((a,b) => a-b); pm.expect(body.ranges[key]).to.eql({ min: sorted.length ? sorted[0] : null, max: sorted.length ? sorted[sorted.length-1] : null }); }));

pm.test('App can filter locally', () => { if (!body.vehicles.length) return; const make = body.vehicles[0].make.slug; const matches = body.vehicles.filter(car => car.make.slug === make); pm.expect(matches.length).to.equal(body.options.makes.find(item => item.slug === make).count); });
